simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מֶתֶק (H4986) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מֶתֶק (metheq) means figuratively, pleasantness (of discourse) First listed occurrence: Prov 16 21.

definitions.full: H4986. metheq מֶ֫תֶק noun masculine Prov 16:21 sweetness ; construct ׳מ שְׂפָתַיִם 16:21 i.e. agreeable, attractive speech, so probably ׳מ רֵעֵהוּ 27:9 the sweetness of one's friend , i.e. of his speech.
